name: MineGeoTech Scholarship (UQ)
summary: Aspire scheme scholarship for regional or remote Queensland Commitment Scholarship holders starting a STEM program at UQ.
who: Domestic student commencing any UQ bachelor program in Semester 1, with no prior bachelor-level study.
Maximum EAS Financial Hardship points and awarded The Queensland Commitment Scholarship.
Resident of an Outer Regional, Remote or Very Remote area in the year before starting.
Studying a program with a significant component of STEM.
how: Apply using the online form. One application covers all scholarships in the Aspire Scholarship scheme.
catches: Applications opened 17 August 2026 and close 26 February 2027.

evidence.quote: are a resident of an Outer Regional, Remote or Very Remote area in the year prior to commencing studies
